summary: KubeCoderDeploy 4dda8ce on phase/028-P4: Jenkinsfile.promote records a release instead of refusing when prd is already at the commit and no release-* tag points at it. The tag is numbered after the build writing it, and the message says the commit was already on prd. A tagged commit still refuses, and the other paths are unchanged. Promotion, record-only and every refusal were hand-run against a scratch repo, and kc project lint/test pass.
